title: `var` infers an array literal whose elements all have one type, and refuses every other with the type to write
scope:
A bare array literal under `var` — a local's initializer and a `var` value binding's `foreach`
subject — and the one function in `nvs-types` that types it. Every other position with no target
keeps `array<mixed>`, and a written `array<T>` is accepted everywhere it was.
dependsOnText:

[0251](0251.md) (a `foreach` binding may write `var`),
[0114](0114.md) (the synthesis, designed for the editor),
[0007](0007.md) (an array literal is checked against its target).
